githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.5 Beta 7 adds a native Discord sticker picker and reorganizes Settings around clearer privacy, storage, downloads, and diagnostics controls. It also improves Settings search navigation and action consistency throughout the app.

## Stickers

- Added a native picker for browsing and searching favorite, frequently used, server, and Discord sticker-pack stickers.
- Added keyboard navigation, animated sticker previews, section shortcuts, and context-menu actions for favoriting stickers or copying their IDs and image links.
- Added sticker sending from any server, using Discord’s native send path when available and an image upload when needed.
- Made sticker sends appear immediately in the conversation while delivery is in progress, with retry handling when a send fails.

## Settings search and organization

- Improved Settings search with hover selection, arrow-key and Control-N/Control-P navigation, Return to open the selected result, and clearer highlighting of the destination control.
- Reorganized Privacy so typing indicators, automatic read acknowledgements, external-link protection, trusted domains, and local activity controls are easier to find.
- Added flexible external-link confirmation options and a dedicated searchable screen for adding or removing trusted domains.
- Consolidated media cache and drafts under a single local storage limit, with combined usage reporting and simpler cleanup controls.
- Made the default download folder easier to select and added consistent Save As and direct save-to-folder actions to media menus.

## Diagnostics and interface polish

- Refined Diagnostics status cards and support summaries with voice latency and clearer Mac hardware and storage details.
- Standardized ellipses on actions that open another view, prompt, or dialog.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.5-Beta-6...v0.1.5-Beta-7](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.5-Beta-6...v0.1.5-Beta-7)
discordAnnouncement:
**Sticker picker and streamlined settings 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Browse and search stickers from Favorites, Frequently Used, Discord packs, and your servers
- Favorite stickers, navigate entirely by keyboard, and copy sticker IDs or image links
- Send stickers from any server, with immediate in-chat previews while they’re being sent
- Settings search now supports keyboard selection and opens directly on the highlighted control
- Privacy adds flexible link confirmations and a searchable Trusted Domains manager
- Storage, downloads, and diagnostics have cleaner layouts and more focused controls
